# Classical models — summary (generated by scripts/export_report.py from results/)

Protocol: leave-one-subject-out (48 folds; 45 for tasks that need a rating). Unit = one 4-s epoch.
Fold metrics = mean ± std over test subjects. **T3 per-fold metrics are undefined** (each subject has one T3 class), so T3 is read from the pooled and per-recording columns.
`rest_baseline` = features z-scored with the subject's own rest epochs (can inflate T1, see D9).
